citations.passage:
The linearity assumption behind d-004 does not hold for archival material;
batching and preprocessing now set the schedule, not API capacity.

Later contradicted by the latency benchmark in
s-006, which found archival page scans far below the assumed rate.

judge.rationale: The reference identifies OCR latency benchmark evidence from session s-006 on real archival page scans, which ran at roughly 40% of the assumed throughput after preprocessing and invalidated d-004’s linearity assumption. The agent incorrectly states that no evidence was found.
